purpose: Compare the two predeclared exact external root-closure variants on the frozen offline LP-state census.

variants.IR1: Full closure with globally valid mixed IR-IN and IR-OUT inequalities.
variants.IR2: Full closure with the IR1 mixed inequalities plus nondominated interval-local projected companions.

common_contract.root_closure_stop: no strict violation or LP infeasibility

live_entry_gate.alternative: one LP-infeasibility closure plus another strict violation

candidate_selection: Only a variant satisfying the live entry gate may be selected.
Prefer IR1 when projected companions are redundant at closure.
Prefer IR2 only when its nondominated projected rows provide strictly stronger closure without invalidity.
Final-MIP runtime is forbidden as a selection signal at this stage.
failure_disposition: If neither variant passes, classify the direction as an offline negative and do not open a live stage.
